root_idea.summary: The root centers on flourishing, ease, pleasant living, and a good or sound condition, extending to bestowed benefit, prosperity, enjoyment, and valued livestock.
root_idea.development: The lexical branches develop from thriving and pleasant life to favor or blessing conferred on another, abundant enjoyment or bliss, and livestock understood as a valuable form of prosperity. Several specialized and figurative uses arise through resemblance or association with softness, flourishing, or ease.

senses.definition: A formula of commendation: excellent, very good, or best is …
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the fixed praise construction نِعْمَ, opposed to بِئْسَ in blame; it may be followed by a noun or predicate identifying what is praised.

senses.definition: To cause someone to enjoy ease, prosperity, and a pleasant state of life; to make comfortable or favored.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use presents a person as being placed in a condition of نعمة, ease, and plentiful living.

senses.definition: To bestow a favor, benefit, or grace upon someone; to confer благation or benefaction.
senses.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with عَلَى and a recipient. In the explicitly described Quranic usage, the recipient is a rational or speaking being.

senses.definition: Abundant enjoyment, bliss, delight, or prosperous ease.
senses.usage_conditions: Often denotes the abundant or enduring enjoyment associated with blessed life, including the Quranic gardens of bliss.

senses.definition: Prosperity, favor, or a favorable condition, especially as contrasted with adversity or affliction.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as the counterpart of ضرّاء or بأساء, including the state of well-being that follows hardship.

senses.definition: A benefit, favor, blessing, bounty, or other good bestowed upon someone; a beneficial or well-being-producing condition.
senses.usage_conditions: The form can denote one favor or the category of favor generally, whether small or abundant. Quranic uses commonly present the favor as bestowed by God.

senses.definition: Soft, pleasant, or enjoying ease and comfort.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the feminine singular form modifying faces; the adjective itself is not restricted to that object class.

senses.definition: Livestock or domesticated grazing animals, including camels, cattle, sheep, and goats.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage the plural term is broad and may refer to livestock generally, while the related singular نَعَمٌ is especially associated with camels or pastoral livestock.

senses.definition: Ease, pleasant living, comfort, or pleasant things.
senses.usage_conditions: This vocalized noun belongs to the branch of enjoying a soft and comfortable life, distinct from نِعْمَةٌ in the sense of a bestowed favor or blessing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become plentiful, easy, good, or pleasant in life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of life or a person's condition; this is distinct in vocalization and meaning from the Quranic praise formula نِعْمَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become soft or tender, especially to the feet.
To nourish well, pamper, or indulge someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader causative use is distinct from placing someone in a generally comfortable or prosperous state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do something thoroughly or well, including kneading it well, bruising or powdering it finely, or cooking it well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are task-oriented uses of Form IV, distinct from conferring a favor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enjoy or lead a plentiful, pleasant, soft, and easy life; to live in comfort and ease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the general sense of enjoying what provides ease and good living.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a tree or plant, to become flourishing, fresh, luxuriant, succulent, soft, or tender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to growing vegetation and its fresh or sappy condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ease, prosperity, or a good condition, the opposite of hardship; also a plural form is associated with أَنْعُم.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct noun from the affirmation نَعَمْ and from the cattle term نَعَمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Yes, indeed, or even so.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An affirmative response particle, distinct from the livestock noun نَعَمٌ and the praise formula نِعْمَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wealth or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited lexical distinction associates this sense especially with the form used with the definite article, whereas the unmarked form commonly denotes a benefit or favor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act or state of rejoicing in something; joy, pleasure, or comfort of the eye in related expressions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct from نِعْمَةٌ ‘favor’ and نَعْمَةٌ ‘ease or pleasant living’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prosperity, ease, or well-being, the opposite of misery or hardship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The paired noun نَعْمَاءُ denotes favorable condition in contrast with بأساءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gentle south wind.
To walk lightly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily-motion use, distinct from living in ease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk barefoot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage reported for the verb; it should not be merged with the meaning ‘to live comfortably’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a place or land, to suit or accord with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's finding a place agreeable or fitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The blackness of night.
An ostrich; in some usage, specifically a female ostrich.
In the idiom شَالَتْ نَعَامَتُهُمْ, the dispersal or breaking up of a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use, not a general meaning of the bird noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A compound term for the shank-bone or a vein of the leg, the middle or beaten track of a road, a brisk horse, or the water-drawer at the head of a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These senses occur in the compound ابن النعامة and are not general meanings of نَعَامَة alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shade or shelter made on a mountain, and a structure at a well, by resemblance in form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or comparative extension based on the appearance of the ostrich or livestock-related form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden support or framework of a well; نَعَامَتَانِ may denote the paired well supports.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical well-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group of stars and the twentieth lunar mansion, traditionally divided into two groups of stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wooden pieces erected over a well to suspend the water-drawing apparatus when fixed supports are absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical well-related plural term, distinct from the astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Softness, tenderness, bloom, or flourishing freshness of youth, youthfulness, a branch, or similar growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical specialization of the نَعْمَة branch; the Quranic occurrences support ease and pleasant living rather than this object-specific use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft, tender, smooth, or sleek, especially of a plant or tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to vegetation or its texture, distinct from the Quranic description of faces enjoying comfort.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, white on the forelegs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive term for a horse's markings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plural of a plural of نَعَمٌ, referring to cattle or livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical and lexical plural formation related to the livestock noun.

The unit defines both نُعْمَى and the paired نَعْمَاءُ.

cautions: The Quranic praise formula نِعْمَ, the affirmative particle نَعَمْ, and the livestock noun نَعَمٌ/أَنْعَامٌ are distinct lexical items despite their shared consonants.
نِعْمَةٌ ‘favor or blessing’ and نَعْمَةٌ ‘ease or pleasant living’ are kept distinct by vocalization and lexical evidence.
The active-participle Quranic form نَاعِمَةٌ is normalized under the citation form نَاعِمٌ; its Quranic occurrence is feminine singular.
The cited Quranic evidence for نَعْمَاءُ is assigned using the supplied QAC location and lexical explanations; no historical Lane bracket notation has been converted into a modern verse location.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The expression نَعِمَ اللَّهُ بِكَ عَيْنًا / نَعِمَكَ عَيْنًا is preserved in the evidence, but its explanation is incomplete or supplied only by a redirect, so it is not assigned an independent meaning.
